title: Ruth Paine at Naushon Island retreat with Dulles's mistress

tellings.quote: Yeah. No, this is correct. Um, she actually vacationed the summer of 1963 at a place called Nashon Island, which is right up near Martha's Vineyard in Massachusetts.

plain: In the summer of 1963, Ruth Paine, a figure in the story of President Kennedy's assassination, vacationed on Naushon Island near Martha's Vineyard, a retreat linked to the Forbes family, alongside Mary Bancroft, the mistress of the former CIA director Allen Dulles. A lawyer and researcher named Dan Sheehan confirms this to Michels from his own research, without naming a source, as a link between Paine and the Dulles circle months before the assassination.
